accent.note: Varies per theme family; swamp-dark reference shown.

body.purpose: Default UI copy, messages, drawer fields.

mono.purpose: Stats strip, chips, code blocks, token counts.

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Top bar and sidebar chrome; 40×40px, hover inverts to accent.

narrative.overview: Minnow is a CSS-token-driven local AI workspace: conversation first, metrics as instrumentation, borders instead of card stacks. Sixteen palette themes share one --mn-* vocabulary. No React component library; primitives are CSS classes plus DOM factories in src/ui/.
keyCharacteristics: Hex/rgba only in tokens.css; --mn-* everywhere else
Family accent on send, links, user bubbles (--mn-accent-soft)
JetBrains Mono for metrics and code
Flat chrome; mobile sidebar shadow only
Semantic metric colors never used for navigation chrome

rules.name: The Accent Rule
rules.body: Family accent appears on primary actions, selection, and links. It does not wash large backgrounds except logo mark and send button.

rules.name: The Metric Color Rule
rules.body: Success, warning, and danger are for measurement only. Never use them for navigation chrome or decorative gradients.

rules.name: The 72ch Rule
rules.body: Assistant markdown bubbles cap at min(720px, 72ch) for readable line length.

rules.name: The Flat Chrome Rule
rules.body: Top bar, sidebar, input bar, and stats strip do not use box-shadow at rest.

dos: Do use (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) for hover-heavy styles
Do treat stats as instrumentation with mono and tabular nums
donts: Don't use neon cyber HUD patterns
Don't mimic generic ChatGPT clones with cream cards or purple gradients
Don't build hero-metric dashboards with colored top stripes
Don't use glassmorphism or gradient text
Don't add colored border-left stripes on cards or alerts
Don't put hex literals outside tokens.css
